about: Test vectors of @whz/det (packages/det). Each entry lists the inputs and the expected `out`. Built by packages/det/scripts/make-data.ts; a port must reproduce every entry.

rng.about: `state` is [a, b, c, counter] right after seeding (the warm-up included); `next` holds the outputs that follow. The other lists are consecutive draws from a fresh generator of the given seed and stream.

ease.about: One table per easing: the fixed-point weight for t = 0 .. EASE_STEPS.
